The '''2014–15 National First Division''' was the 2014–15 season of the [[National First Division]], the second tier of South Africa's professional [[association football|football]]. It was played from September 2014 until May 2015 and was won by [[Lamontville Golden Arrows F.C.|Golden Arrows]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=PSL congratulates Arrows - ABSA Premiership 2014/15 - Golden Arrows |url=https://africanfootball.com/news/529374/PSL-congratulates-Arrows |access-date=2023-12-22 |website=African Football}}</ref>
